name: Galileo SH1
summary: A 1.72 m dual-arm robot with a head and torso on an omnidirectional wheeled base, 5 kg per arm and about 4 h runtime, sold in China on request.

germany.statusNote: Galileo sells from Tianjin by phone and email (intent orders); no EU office, distributor or customer found. Only a US-run German-language shop (Roboter Deutschland) lists it as a quote item with no price.

specs.label: Base speed
specs.conditions: omnidirectional base, turns on the spot

specs.label: End effectors
specs.value: Optional: 2-finger gripper, 3-finger hand (with or without touch sensing), 5-finger hand

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: Binocular head camera; 2 wrist depth cameras and 2 six-axis wrist force sensors; 4 RGB cameras and 2 IMUs in the torso; 3D LiDAR and 8 ultrasonic sensors in the base

capabilities.sdk: Secondary development supported; no public SDK documentation found
notes: Wheeled humanoid: head, torso and two arms on a single bending column over a wheeled base, so it is listed as a humanoid.
End effector is chosen at order (gripper or 3- or 5-finger hand); what comes as standard is not stated.
Stairs set to false because it rolls on a wheeled base.
